title: Allow user-defined labels for Bluetooth UUIDs
description:
Adds a UAT to the Bluetooth dissector to allow the user to define custom
labels for Bluetooth UUIDs that have meaning to them.

Behind the scenes, adds the user-specified UUIDs and labels to the
`bluetooth_uuids` structure in `packet-bluetooth.c` so the changes
appear in the Bluetooth ATT Server Attributes dialog, among other
places.

Does not currently prevent duplicate UUID entries. Could be added.

Could be moved to `packet-btatt.c` to make it slightly more
discoverable.

Closes #17808
